title: Return to Athos with a month-long visa via the CIA Athens chief; Saint Anne's skete
summary: Ralph tells of Return to Athos with a month-long visa via the CIA Athens chief; Saint Anne's skete, about 2005 at Greece (the ancient oracle sites), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I still had all my contacts and friends at CIA, including the guy who was head of our office in Athens, right? And uh I lined it up with him.

plain: A former CIA officer known as Ralph told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2005 he went back to Mount Athos, a mountain in Greece where only monks live and visitors need special permits. He says he still had friends at the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, including the head of its office in Athens, who helped him get a month-long visa. He says he stayed at Saint Anne's skete, a small community of monks, as part of a larger spiritual search he describes.
